funny-girls.title: Funny Girls Blackpool: Show Night Guide | Blackpool.gay
funny-girls.description: Planning a night at Funny Girls Blackpool? Show nights, ticket price ranges, the dinner option and which hotels are only a few minutes' walk from the door.
funny-girls.h1: A Night at Funny Girls on Dickson Road
funny-girls.intro: Funny Girls is Blackpool's flagship drag cabaret, and the easiest way to anchor a whole evening, with several hotels a short stroll from the door.
funny-girls.body_html:
What is Funny Girls like?

Funny Girls is the big-ticket night of a Blackpool gay weekend. Forget a pub turn: this is a proper theatre production with a live company of queens, sparkling costume changes, a comic host and a fresh themed show every season. The venue is a 1939 cinema with art deco styling on Dickson Road, and it has been entertaining visitors since 1994. New owners took over in 2026 and extended the staging so the performers work much closer to the audience. Entry is 18+ only.

When should you go?

Show nights run Wednesday to Sunday. Doors open at 7pm, a host and DJ warm things up from 8pm, and the main show starts around 8:30pm, finishing at about 11:30pm. The box office phone line is staffed Monday to Friday, 9:30am to 5:30pm. Productions rotate by season, so see what's on for whichever run is playing when you visit.

What does a night at Funny Girls cost?

Listed prices begin at about £10 for standing, and seats run from roughly £17 to £35 depending on the night. A three-course supper in the venue's restaurant is listed at £29.85 per person, served from 6pm ahead of the show.

Which stays are closest?

Walking times below are approximate.

  • Pride Lodge: about 2 minutes on foot
  • Q Accommodation: about 2 minutes on foot
  • Welhorny's: about 2 minutes on foot

See all options on our stays page, or check open tonight and more bars near your hotel.

Good to know

  • Friday and Saturday sell out first, so book early for weekends.
  • Some numbers use pyrotechnics and loud bangs.
  • Ring the box office about access needs before you buy.
  • Celebrating something? You can dress your table or bring a cake.
  • A taxi rank is outside, and Blackpool North station is about two minutes away on foot.
  • Oscars, next door in the same complex, keeps the party going after the show.

oscars.title: Oscars Blackpool: After-Show Late Bar | Blackpool.gay
oscars.description: Oscars is the late bar attached to Funny Girls. See which nights it opens, how late it runs and which hotels are a short walk from the after-show party.
oscars.h1: Oscars: the After-Show Bar on Dickson Road
oscars.intro: Oscars is where the Funny Girls audience drifts once the curtain drops: a late lounge with karaoke and live music, handy if your hotel is close.
oscars.body_html:
What is Oscars like?

Think of Oscars as the encore. It shares a roof with the cabaret on Dickson Road, so there is no taxi to organise and no coat to chase: you walk out of the theatre and straight into the lounge. Expect karaoke, live music and a crowd still buzzing from the show. On Fridays and Saturdays it opens earlier in the evening, so it can double as a spot to gather your group before curtain up.

When should you go?

Hours are short and tied to the show. Listed times are Wednesday 11pm to 1am, Thursday 11pm to 2am, and Friday and Saturday 9pm to 2am. It stays shut from Sunday to Tuesday. Since midweek opening depends on the performance finishing, confirm before building a late midweek plan around it.

What does a night at Oscars cost?

No prices are listed for Oscars. Groups can arrange bookings by email through the venue, and the show's box office team can answer general questions.

Which stays are closest?

Walking times below are approximate.

  • Q Accommodation: about 1 minute on foot
  • Pride Lodge: about 2 minutes on foot
  • Welhorny's: about 2 minutes on foot

See all options on our stays page, or check open tonight and more bars near your hotel.

Good to know

  • Closed Sunday to Tuesday.
  • On Wednesday and Thursday it opens late, once the show ends.
  • For a later finish at weekends, Queen Street is about two minutes away on foot.
  • Pair it with a show ticket for an easy one-address evening.

For a deeper profile of Oscars, the Rainbow Quarter venue directory has it.

the-flying-handbag.title: Flying Handbag Blackpool: Hours & Nights | Blackpool.gay
the-flying-handbag.description: The Flying Handbag Blackpool opens daily, running to 3am or 4am. See the weekly nights, food times, ID rules and which stays sit closest on Queen Street.
the-flying-handbag.h1: The Flying Handbag: Queen Street's Anchor Bar
the-flying-handbag.intro: The Flying Handbag is the all-day, all-week bar at the heart of Queen Street, which makes it a natural anchor for a weekend with a hotel close by.
the-flying-handbag.body_html:
What is The Flying Handbag like?

Most visitors end up here at some point. It was designed from scratch as an LGBTQ+ venue, with a curved bar, a stage for cabaret, a glazed conservatory and a sun terrace, and the mix of drag hosting, karaoke, quizzes and DJs keeps the week varied. By day it is a laid-back spot for lunch and a drink; after dark it gets loud and packed. It has occupied its Queen Street corner since 2006. It is 18+ and checks ID.

When should you go?

Listed hours are noon until 3am every day, stretching to 4am on Friday and Saturday. Food is served Monday to Thursday from 1pm to 12:30am, Friday and Saturday from 1pm to 1:30am, and Sunday from noon to 5pm. Regular nights include Monday Mayhem, QuizMania on Wednesday afternoons, Thursday game shows and Miss Amber, TFI Friday and Sunday lunch. The detail is on what's on.

What does a night at The Flying Handbag cost?

No entry or drink prices are listed here, so look at the venue's own pages before you go.

Which stays are closest?

Walking times below are approximate.

  • Pride Lodge: about 1 minute on foot
  • Q Accommodation: about 2 minutes on foot
  • Welhorny's: about 3 minutes on foot

See all options on our stays page, or check open tonight and more bars near your hotel.

Good to know

  • Bring photo ID: it is 18+.
  • Reserve a booth if you have a big group on Friday or Saturday.
  • Sunday lunch is the calmer way to get to know the place.
  • Wheelchair access is listed.
  • The sun terrace is a bonus when the weather plays ball.

garlands.title: Garlands Blackpool: Free Daily Drag | Blackpool.gay
garlands.description: Garlands on Talbot Road has free-entry drag every day and opens to 2am or 3am. Check listed hours, what to expect and the hotels within a short walk.
garlands.h1: Garlands: Free Drag Every Day on Talbot Road
garlands.intro: Garlands is the budget-friendly drag stop near Blackpool North station, with no cover charge and queens performing from the middle of the afternoon, daily.
garlands.body_html:
What is Garlands like?

Fancy drag without buying a ticket? This is your answer. Garlands is a compact, recently refreshed bar on Talbot Road, close to the station end of town. Resident queens host from mid-afternoon, guest cabaret acts rotate through the week, and the mood is cheeky and sing-along. It fills quickly on cabaret nights, and it makes an easy first drink if you arrive by train and want to dump your bags nearby first.

When should you go?

Listed hours are noon to 2am Monday to Wednesday and on Sunday, and noon to 3am Thursday to Saturday. Drag is listed daily, with performers starting around 3pm. Performers vary week to week, so look at the venue's own pages, or our open tonight page, for the current week.

What does a night at Garlands cost?

Free entry is listed. Drink prices are not given here.

Which stays are closest?

Walking times below are approximate.

  • Pride Lodge: about 3 minutes on foot
  • Q Accommodation: about 4 minutes on foot
  • Welhorny's: about 4 minutes on foot

See all options on our stays page, or check open tonight and more bars near your hotel.

Good to know

  • Arrive early on cabaret nights if you want a seat.
  • Handy for a first drink straight off the train.
  • Themed parties pop up on bank holiday weekends.
  • No accessibility information is listed, so ring ahead if you need step-free access.

peek-a-booze.title: Peek-a-Booze Blackpool: Bar & Rooms | Blackpool.gay
peek-a-booze.description: Peek-a-Booze, along Dickson Road, mixes cabaret nights, bingo and karaoke with adults-only rooms above. Hours, what's on each night and stays close by.
peek-a-booze.intro: Peek-a-Booze is a cabaret bar on Dickson Road with adults-only budget rooms above it, so your stay can sit directly on top of your night out.
peek-a-booze.body_html:
What is Peek-a-Booze like?

The recipe is simple and very seaside: a friendly bar on the ground floor, bedrooms overhead and something happening most evenings. The week runs on bingo and game shows, karaoke sessions and live singers, with guest drag acts as the weekend arrives. There is an outdoor terrace, and the kitchen starts serving at breakfast. Funny Girls and Man Bar are along the same road, so you can wander between three venues without needing transport.

When should you go?

Listed hours are 9am to midnight Monday to Thursday, and 9am to 1am Friday to Sunday. Food runs daily from 9am to 7pm. A typical week: bingo and Blankety Blank on Monday, karaoke on Tuesday, free bingo from 7pm and a Play Your Cards Right game at 9pm on Wednesday, and karaoke Thursday, before the weekend shows.

What does a night at Peek-a-Booze cost?

No standard prices are listed. Wednesday's free bingo makes a cheap night out, and it is worth asking about room-and-show deals if you are booking Funny Girls.

Which stays are closest?

Walking times below are approximate. This venue has rooms of its own: see its stay page.

  • Chaps Hotel: about 1 minute on foot
  • The B&B Blackpool: about 1 minute on foot
  • The Belvedere: about 2 minutes on foot

See all options on our stays page, or check open tonight and more bars near your hotel.

  • Rooms are adults-only.
  • Upstairs is reached by stairs only; there is no lift.
  • Wednesday free bingo is the budget pick.
  • Ask about room-and-show packages for Funny Girls.

mardi-gras.title: Mardi Gras Blackpool: Bar, Roast & Rooms | Blackpool.gay
mardi-gras.description: Mardi Gras on Lord Street is a three-area LGBTQ+ bar with cabaret, hot food and rooms. Hours, Sunday roast tips and the stays within a short walk.
mardi-gras.h1: Mardi Gras: Cabaret, Pool and Sunday Roast
mardi-gras.intro: Mardi Gras packs a cabaret room, a main bar and a quiet lounge under one roof on Lord Street, with rooms upstairs if you want to stay put.
mardi-gras.body_html:
What is Mardi Gras like?

Three different moods share one building. One area has cabaret, live music and a dancefloor, another is the busy main bar, and the chesterfield lounge is a no-music zone with a pool table for proper conversations. Cheap drinks and hot food are part of the appeal, along with comedians and cabaret acts through the year. Upstairs are en-suite bedrooms, while Q Accommodation, a sister guest house, is just along the street.

When should you go?

Listed hours: noon to midnight Monday to Thursday, noon to 3am on Friday, and 10am to 3am on Saturday and Sunday. Bank holidays run noon to midnight. Sunday roasts start from 1:30pm, and it is wise to reserve a table on a busy weekend.

What does a night at Mardi Gras cost?

No set prices are listed. Drinks are described as keenly priced and hot food is on the menu, though no figures are given.

Which stays are closest?

Walking times below are approximate. This venue has rooms of its own: see its stay page.

  • Q Accommodation: about 1 minute on foot
  • Welhorny's: about 1 minute on foot
  • Pride Lodge: about 2 minutes on foot

See all options on our stays page, or check open tonight and more bars near your hotel.

Good to know

  • Book Sunday lunch ahead on busy weekends.
  • The chesterfield lounge is the quiet corner.
  • Rooms are upstairs, reached by stairs with handrails and no lift.
  • Bookings for both Mardi Gras and Q Accommodation go through the bar.

man-bar-growlr-club.title: Man Bar Blackpool: Weekend Bears Guide | Blackpool.gay
man-bar-growlr-club.description: Man Bar, on Dickson Road, opens at weekends with a pool table, and a Growlr men-only club above. Hours, wristband entry and hotels close by for bear fans.
man-bar-growlr-club.h1: Man Bar and Growlr Club: Bears on Dickson Road
man-bar-growlr-club.intro: Man Bar is a no-nonsense weekend bar on Dickson Road, with a men-only club above it that leans towards the bear community.
man-bar-growlr-club.body_html:
What is Man Bar and Growlr Club like?

Think pool table, drinks deals and an unfussy crowd. Man Bar sits a few doors from Funny Girls and keeps a traditional, down-to-earth feel. Above it is Growlr Club, reserved for men and reached by picking up a wristband downstairs. Expect lockers and a terrace for smokers, and it draws the bear scene in particular. Visiting party nights appear through the year, and a refurbishment across 2025 and 2026 has given the whole place a brighter look.

When should you go?

The bar opens Friday, Saturday and Sunday from 8pm, finishing at 2am. Growlr Club upstairs is listed for Friday and Saturday, roughly 9pm until 2am. Monday to Thursday it is closed. Gin & Bear It, the calmer lounge, sits next door.

What does a night at Man Bar and Growlr Club cost?

The club is entered by wristband from the bar; no wristband price is listed here.

Which stays are closest?

Walking times below are approximate.

  • Q Accommodation: about 1 minute on foot
  • Welhorny's: about 1 minute on foot
  • Pride Lodge: about 2 minutes on foot

See all options on our stays page, or check open tonight and more bars near your hotel.

Good to know

  • Growlr Club is men only and 18+.
  • Use a locker upstairs for valuables.
  • Weekend-only opening, so plan for Friday to Sunday.
  • Gin & Bear It next door is the quieter place to start.

Want the full background on Man Bar and Growlr Club? Browse the venue directory on Rainbow Quarter.

gin-and-bear-it.title: Gin & Bear It Blackpool: Weekend Cocktails | Blackpool.gay
gin-and-bear-it.description: Cosy weekend gin lounge Gin & Bear It (Springfield Road) sits beside Man Bar. See opening times, what to order and which stays are a short walk away.
gin-and-bear-it.h1: Gin & Bear It: the Quiet Room by Man Bar
gin-and-bear-it.intro: Gin & Bear It is the slow-down option beside Man Bar, a snug gin lounge on Springfield Road that works as a relaxed start to your night.
gin-and-bear-it.body_html:
What is Gin & Bear It like?

After the thump of Dickson Road, this is where you can actually hold a conversation. It is a cocktail-minded lounge with its own entrance on Springfield Road and a gin menu that stretches to roughly two hundred bottles. Staff will pair a tonic and garnish to your taste, so you do not need to know your juniper from your citrus. People who have been describe it as inclusive and a comfortable place to be yourself.

When should you go?

It follows the weekend rhythm of its neighbour: Fridays to Sundays, 8pm onwards, with a listed 2am finish. Midweek it is closed, so build it into a weekend trip.

What does a night at Gin & Bear It cost?

No prices are listed. If the menu feels daunting, ask at the bar for a suggestion.

Which stays are closest?

Walking times below are approximate.

  • Q Accommodation: about 1 minute on foot
  • Welhorny's: about 1 minute on foot
  • Pride Lodge: about 2 minutes on foot

See all options on our stays page, or check open tonight and more bars near your hotel.

Good to know

  • Weekends only, from 8pm.
  • A good calm drink before the busier bars.
  • Shares a phone number and website with Man Bar.
  • Dickson Road is just around the corner.

For a deeper profile of Gin & Bear It, the Rainbow Quarter venue directory has it.

trades.title: Trades Hotel Blackpool: Men-Only Bar | Blackpool.gay
trades.description: Men-only hotel Trades, on Lord Street, has a members' bar open daily until 3am. Who it suits, listed hours and the other stays within walking distance.
trades.h1: Trades: Men-Only Hotel and Late Bar
trades.intro: Trades is a men-only hotel with its own bar on Lord Street, so you can book a room and have a drink downstairs without leaving the building.
trades.body_html:
What is Trades Hotel and Bar like?

Trades belongs to a classic seaside tradition: the sociable, men-only LGBTQ+ hotel. A run of linked townhouses on Lord Street holds around 60 rooms, and guests join as members for the duration of their stay. The bar is an easygoing place for men to chat and meet, and the property was refurbished in 2026. If you are hunting for a men only hotel in Blackpool with a bar on site, this is the one to look at first.

When should you go?

The bar is listed as open daily from 11am until 3am. Because it works as a residents' bar, check the membership and entry arrangements with the hotel before turning up on spec.

What does a night at Trades Hotel and Bar cost?

No prices are listed here. Contact the hotel for current room rates.

Which stays are closest?

Walking times below are approximate. This venue has rooms of its own: see its stay page.

  • The B&B Blackpool: about 1 minute on foot
  • Welhorny's: about 1 minute on foot
  • Chaps Hotel: about 2 minutes on foot

See all options on our stays page, or check open tonight and more bars near your hotel.

Good to know

  • Men only, 18+.
  • Open every day, which suits a flexible trip.
  • Lord Street puts you within a few minutes' walk of every bar in the quarter.
  • An older, separate Trades Bar once stood on Queen Street; that is a different building.

More detail on Trades Hotel and Bar sits in the Rainbow Quarter guide to the scene.

neon-bar.title: Neon Bar Blackpool: Cocktails & Garden | Blackpool.gay
neon-bar.description: Neon Bar, tucked on Yates Street, serves cocktails with a garden behind and links to adults-only Hotel Neon. Likely hours, pre-drinks tips, nearby stays.
neon-bar.h1: Neon Bar: Cocktails and a Garden Off Lord Street
neon-bar.intro: Neon is a smart little cocktail bar connected to an adults-only hotel, and it makes a good first stop before Lord Street picks up speed.
neon-bar.body_html:
What is Neon Bar and Hotel Neon like?

Neon is one of the calmer corners of the quarter. You will find it at the Yates Street end of Lord Street, serving premium spirits and cocktails, with a garden behind. A refurbished adults-only hotel shares the building, so you can pair a drink with a bed right among the guest-house streets. Mardi Gras and Trades are only a minute or two away on foot, which makes it handy for pre-drinks.

When should you go?

Opening times are not published. The bar is usually open from Thursday to Sunday, so check ahead, especially midweek or in winter.

What does a night at Neon Bar and Hotel Neon cost?

No prices are listed.

rendezvous.title: Rendezvous Blackpool: Afternoon Bar | Blackpool.gay
rendezvous.description: Compact Rendezvous offers afternoon drinks with bedrooms above, near the railway end of Lord Street. Listed hours, entertainment days and nearby stays.
rendezvous.h1: Rendezvous: Early Drinks at the Station End
rendezvous.intro: Rendezvous is a compact afternoon-and-early-evening bar on Lord Street, ideal if you want a relaxed start and a bedroom just upstairs.
rendezvous.body_html:
What is Rendezvous Bar and Rooms like?

Small, cheerful and early to bed, Rendezvous works best as chapter one of your night. Something is usually happening on its open days, singers one day, drag the next; a Jane McDonald tribute by Marigold Addams has played here. Bedrooms above mean you can sleep on Lord Street itself, handy for the railway station and the rest of the quarter.

When should you go?

Listed hours are Thursday 5pm to 10pm, Friday 2pm to 10pm, Saturday 2pm to 10:30pm and Sunday 3pm to 10pm. It is closed Monday and Tuesday, and Wednesday hours should be checked.

What does a night at Rendezvous Bar and Rooms cost?

No prices are listed.

Which stays are closest?

Walking times below are approximate. This venue has rooms of its own: see its stay page.

  • Go in the afternoon or early evening, as it closes around 10pm.
  • Save the late bars for after you leave.
  • Entertainment is typical on most open days, so ask what is on.
  • Rooms are available on site.

mcgraths.title: McGraths Blackpool: Drag Bar & Rooms | Blackpool.gay
mcgraths.description: McGraths on Lord Street pairs a bar with resident drag, singers and cabaret with an adults-only guest house upstairs. Opening notes and stays nearby.
mcgraths.h1: McGraths: Resident Drag and a Guest House
mcgraths.intro: McGraths is a lively Lord Street bar with an adults-only guest house above, and entertainment on most evenings, Sundays included.
mcgraths.body_html:
What is McGraths Bar and Hotel like?

The ground floor is a welcoming bar and lounge where resident drag queens, singers and touring cabaret acts perform, with a keep-your-labels-in-your-pocket attitude. Overhead, the guest house takes adult guests only; reviewers rate the hosts, cleanliness and breakfast highly, and it was a 2024 finalist at a local hospitality awards event. Seasonal drag nights, such as a Halloween takeover, bring the regulars back.

When should you go?

Opening hours are not published, but entertainment is listed most evenings including Sunday. Check with the venue before travelling, especially for a late finish. On Halloween night, a Sanderson Sisters themed drag takeover is listed from 8pm to 11pm.

What does a night at McGraths Bar and Hotel cost?

No prices are listed.

Which stays are closest?

Walking times below are approximate. This venue has rooms of its own: see its stay page.

Good to know

evanescent.title: Evanescent Blackpool: Cheap Bar & Rooms | Blackpool.gay
evanescent.description: Evanescent, off Lord Street, is a pint-sized bar with adults-only budget rooms upstairs, karaoke and a DJ taking requests. Hours notes and nearby stays.
evanescent.h1: Evanescent: Small Bar, Big Warm-Up on Cocker Street
evanescent.intro: Evanescent is a laid-back little bar with budget bedrooms on Cocker Street, used by many as a warm-up before the bigger venues.
evanescent.body_html:
What is Evanescent Bar and Rooms like?

This one suits people who prefer a snug room and a friendly atmosphere. Evanescent is on Cocker Street, which branches off Lord Street, and the pitch is affordable drinks, a DJ happy to take requests, karaoke and the occasional live performer. The en-suite bedrooms above are aimed at budgets and restricted to adults. Lord Street is about two minutes away and Queen Street roughly five.

When should you go?

Opening hours are not published, so call or check with the venue before relying on it for a particular night. It is better as a pre-drinks stop than a late finish.

What does a night at Evanescent Bar and Rooms cost?

Drinks are described as cheap, but no figures are listed.

churchills.title: Churchills Blackpool: Daytime Pub | Blackpool.gay
churchills.description: Churchills (Topping Street) is a cask-ale pub with karaoke, bingo and a mixed crowd that welcomes LGBTQ+ visitors. Daytime hours and the nearest stays.
churchills.h1: Churchills: A Friendly Daytime Pub Near the Quarter
churchills.intro: Churchills is an easygoing town-centre pub that opens early, a good daytime pint before the Rainbow Quarter wakes up.
churchills.body_html:
What is Churchills like?

This is an old-school pub in a former hotel on Topping Street, a short step south of the Rainbow Quarter. Real ale is the traditional draw, and the clientele is mixed and LGBTQ+ friendly, often slightly older than at the Queen Street bars. Karaoke, bingo and poker evenings keep the diary full. With a 10am start (11am on Sundays), it is a sensible choice while the scene bars are still shut for the day.

When should you go?

Listed hours: 10am to 11pm Monday to Thursday, 10am to 1am Friday and Saturday, and 11am to 1am on Sunday. That makes it one of the few options for a lunchtime drink on a quiet weekday, and a sensible first stop on a weekend morning before the afternoon crowd builds. If you plan to stay late, the Friday and Saturday closing time is the one to note.

What does a night at Churchills cost?

No prices are listed. Cask ales are a feature, so ask at the bar what is on.

Which stays are closest?

  • Quieter, more pub-like feel than Queen Street.
  • Karaoke, bingo and poker nights are regular.

the-blackpool-north.title: Blackpool North Bar & Grill: Near Station | Blackpool.gay
the-blackpool-north.description: Bar and grill The Blackpool North has rooms upstairs, a welcome for LGBTQ+ visitors and midday opening. See why it suits a train arrival and nearby stays.
the-blackpool-north.h1: The Blackpool North: Bar, Grill and Rooms
the-blackpool-north.intro: The Blackpool North is a welcoming bar and grill on the Lord Street and Banks Street corner, a handy first or last stop if you arrive by train.
the-blackpool-north.body_html:
What is The Blackpool North like?

Pride flags fly outside this public bar and grill, which stands slap in the heart of the Rainbow Quarter. Guests staying upstairs, locals and day-trippers drift through on their way between Lord Street and the seafront. The kitchen turns out home-made pub food, with BBQ ribs and nachos among the dishes, and there are rooms and suites above if you would rather not go far.

When should you go?

The public bar is listed as open from midday until late; no exact closing time is published, so check with the venue. It works well in the afternoon, before the bigger bars have filled, and as a place to eat before heading on.

What does a night at The Blackpool North cost?

No prices are listed.

Which stays are closest?

Walking times below are approximate. This venue has rooms of its own: see its stay page.

Good to know

  • Close to Blackpool North station.

  • Funny Girls and Dickson Road are about two minutes away.

the-dame-lane.title: Dame Lane Blackpool: B&B with a Bar | Blackpool.gay
the-dame-lane.description: The Dame Lane (Pleasant Street) pairs bed and breakfast with a bar of its own, bingo afternoons and live singers, and it welcomes dogs. Location notes.
the-dame-lane.h1: The Dame Lane: B&B and Bar on Pleasant Street
the-dame-lane.intro: At the quiet north end of the quarter, The Dame Lane combines bed and breakfast with a bar of its own, and it welcomes dogs and families.
the-dame-lane.body_html:
What is The Dame Lane like?

Guests mention a warm welcome, a cooked breakfast and rooms that have recently been smartened up. The in-house bar adds bingo afternoons, DJ evenings and live singers, so you can sleep and socialise without crossing the road. The building used to trade as The Grampian House. Dogs are welcome, which helps if your four-legged friend is joining the trip, and it is a calmer base than the busy bar streets.

When should you go?

Bar hours are not published, so check with the property before planning a night around it. Bingo is advertised as an afternoon event, with DJs and singers at other times.

What does a night at The Dame Lane cost?

No prices are listed.

Which stays are closest?

Walking times below are approximate. This venue has rooms of its own: see its stay page.

  • The Belvedere: about 2 minutes on foot
  • De-Lovely Hotel: about 2 minutes on foot
  • Westfield House: about 2 minutes on foot

See all options on our stays page, or check open tonight and more bars near your hotel.

Good to know

  • Dog friendly.
  • No lift, so upper floors are on stairs.
  • No on-site parking; street parking nearby is limited.
  • Towards the northern end of the Rainbow Quarter.

lu-lus-cabaret-lounge.title: Lu-Lu's Blackpool: Cabaret & Rooms | Blackpool.gay
lu-lus-cabaret-lounge.description: Lu-Lu's Cabaret Lounge on Dickson Road offers weekend drag, a quieter lounge and en-suite budget rooms. Cash only. Times, tips and stays close by.
lu-lus-cabaret-lounge.h1: Lu-Lu's: Weekend Cabaret and Budget Rooms
lu-lus-cabaret-lounge.intro: Lu-Lu's is a friendly weekend cabaret bar at the north end of Dickson Road, with a quieter lounge beside it and about 26 rooms above.
lu-lus-cabaret-lounge.body_html:
What is Lu-Lu's Cabaret Lounge like?

Two bars sit side by side, so you can pick your mood. The cabaret room stages drag and variety acts with a house DJ and space to dance at weekends, while Sailor Al's next door is the chilled-out lounge. Some Sunday evenings have featured a hosted cocktail session with Crystal Candyfloss. Upstairs are around 26 ensuite bedrooms at the lower end of the price range, so you can sleep where you party.

When should you go?

The cabaret bar is listed for Friday to Sunday from 7pm, with Sailor Al's lounge open Saturday and Sunday from 7pm. Times can change, so check first.

What does a night at Lu-Lu's Cabaret Lounge cost?

It is cash only, so bring cash for drinks.

Which stays are closest?

Walking times below are approximate. This venue has rooms of its own: see its stay page.

  • The Belvedere: about 1 minute on foot
  • Chaps Hotel: about 1 minute on foot
  • The Prince Albert Hotel: about 1 minute on foot

See all options on our stays page, or check open tonight and more bars near your hotel.

Good to know

  • Bring cash.
  • Steps at the entrance; phone ahead if you need step-free access.
  • Weekend-focused opening.
  • The quieter lounge is a good break from the music.

antinous.title: Antinous Blackpool: Lounge & Bistro | Blackpool.gay
antinous.description: Antinous Lounge & Bistro on Banks Street serves food and drinks at a gentler pace than the late bars. See nearby stays and why it suits an early stop.
antinous.h1: Antinous: a Calmer Lounge and Bistro on Banks Street
antinous.intro: Antinous is a relaxed LGBTQ+ friendly lounge and bistro near North Pier, a quieter choice for food and a chat before the late bars warm up.
antinous.body_html:
What is Antinous Lounge & Bistro like?

Most of the quarter is about drinks first; Antinous puts a menu alongside the bar. You will find it on Banks Street, off Lord Street and a short hop from North Pier. Its link to a neighbouring guest house gives it a slower, more sit-down feel than the late-night venues. It also opens its doors for community get-togethers such as charity coffee mornings, which tend to be announced shortly before they happen.

When should you go?

Opening hours are not published, so check before you travel, particularly if you plan to eat there. Because it runs at a gentler tempo, it suits an early evening or a daytime stop rather than a late finish.

What does a night at Antinous Lounge & Bistro cost?

No prices are listed.

Which stays are closest?

Walking times below are approximate.

  • Q Accommodation: about 1 minute on foot
  • Welhorny's: about 1 minute on foot
  • Chaps Hotel: about 2 minutes on foot

See all options on our stays page, or check open tonight and more bars near your hotel.

Good to know

  • Check hours and food service before you go.
  • Trades and Mardi Gras are a short stroll along Lord Street.
  • Community events are announced shortly before the date.
  • Good for a quiet catch-up.

More detail on Antinous Lounge & Bistro sits in the Rainbow Quarter guide to the scene.

acqua-sauna.title: Acqua Sauna Blackpool: Men's Sauna | Blackpool.gay
acqua-sauna.description: Acqua Sauna is a men-only sauna on Springfield Road, near Blackpool North. Entry price, late-night hours, facilities and hotels within walking distance.
acqua-sauna.h1: Acqua Sauna: Men's Sauna on Springfield Road
acqua-sauna.intro: Acqua is a men-only sauna a couple of minutes from Blackpool North station, convenient if your hotel is on the Dickson Road side of town.
acqua-sauna.body_html:
What is Acqua Sauna like?

Acqua calls itself the longest-running sauna for men in the North West. Across several floors you will find a dry sauna, a steam room, a big hot tub, private cabins and a cafe-style lounge. Entry is for men aged 18 and over, and most sessions are men only, with the odd mixed event announced beforehand. Some listings show a Lewtas Street address, but the door is on Springfield Road, tucked behind the Grand Metropole Hotel.

When should you go?

It is listed as open seven days, with late nights running until 6am on Friday and Saturday. Look at the sauna's own website for today's times. A GROWL afternoon, a social session for the bear community, is run here from time to time.

How much does it cost?

Entry is listed from £10, which covers wifi, hot drinks, a locker and a towel. Midweek deals have been offered in the past.

Which stays are closest?

Walking times below are approximate. It is a men-only venue, listed here so you can see what sits near your hotel.

  • Q Accommodation: about 4 minutes on foot
  • Welhorny's: about 4 minutes on foot

See all options on our stays page, or check open tonight and more bars near your hotel.

Good to know

  • Men only and 18+, with a Challenge 25 ID policy.
  • Check the website for today's opening times.
  • The address on some listings is wrong: look for Springfield Road.
  • Late nights run until 6am on Friday and Saturday.

w3-complex.title: W3 Complex Blackpool: Men's Sauna | Blackpool.gay
w3-complex.description: W3 Complex is a men-only sauna on Charles Street with steam, outdoor hot tub, sun terrace. Prices, theme nights and nearby gay-friendly stays.
w3-complex.h1: W3 Complex: Men's Sauna on Charles Street
w3-complex.intro: W3 is a men-only sauna just south-east of the station, with an outdoor hot tub, a terrace and weekly theme nights.
w3-complex.body_html:
What is W3 Complex like?

W3 has traded since 2007 under a former name, WetWetWet, and is one of two men's saunas in town. The ground level offers a dry sauna, a big steam room, an open-air hot tub and a sunny terrace, with more rooms upstairs and a lounge for snacks and drinks. Entry is for men aged 18 and over. A sexual-health testing clinic runs there monthly, as part of local efforts to end new HIV transmissions.

When should you go?

Hours vary: it opens daily from late morning, with later finishes on some nights and weekends. The weekly rota is Naked Thursdays, Underwear Fridays, then late Saturdays; weekends draw the biggest crowds. Check before you travel.

How much does it cost?

Entry is listed at about £10.

Which stays are closest?

Walking times below are approximate. It is a men-only venue, listed here so you can see what sits near your hotel.

  • Pride Lodge: about 5 minutes on foot
  • Q Accommodation: about 6 minutes on foot
  • Welhorny's: about 7 minutes on foot

See all options on our stays page, or check open tonight and more bars near your hotel.

Good to know

  • Men only and 18+.
  • Only the lower level is reported as suitable for disabled visitors.
  • Check times, which change by night.
  • A monthly sexual-health clinic runs here.

nightlife_hub.title: Gay Bars Near Your Hotel in Blackpool | Blackpool.gay
nightlife_hub.description: Gay bars near your hotel in Blackpool: our night out cards show hours, show nights, prices and walking times from each stay to the bars and saunas.
nightlife_hub.h1: Gay Bars Near Your Hotel in Blackpool
nightlife_hub.intro: Pick your hotel first, then choose a night: these short cards show hours, prices and walking times from each stay to the nearest bars.
nightlife_hub.body_html:
How do you choose a bar from your hotel?

Start with where you are sleeping, then work outwards. Blackpool's LGBTQ+ bars are packed into a few streets near Blackpool North station, so almost every stay on our list is within a ten-minute stroll of something good. The question is not whether there is a bar nearby, but which one suits the night you want.

Below is a quick map by mood, followed by walking times from each stay to four of the biggest names. Use our stays pages to pick a base first, or come here if you have already booked.

Which bars suit which kind of night?

  • A big show: Funny Girls on Dickson Road stages the cabaret, and Oscars carries on afterwards.
  • Free drag: Garlands on Talbot Road has no cover charge and performances every day.
  • All-rounder on Queen Street: The Flying Handbag is open daily with karaoke, quizzes and food.
  • Lord Street bars with rooms: Mardi Gras, McGraths, Rendezvous, Neon Bar and Trades (men only).
  • Cabaret on a budget: Peek-a-Booze and Lu-Lu's on Dickson Road.
  • Bears and a quiet gin: Man Bar and Growlr Club and Gin & Bear It, weekends only.
  • Daytime and food: Churchills, The Blackpool North and Antinous.
  • Cosy and small: Evanescent and The Dame Lane.

How far is the nearest bar from your stay?

These walking times come from our own map data and are approximate. Add a few minutes if you are carrying bags or heading out in heels.

Are there men-only options?

Yes. Trades is a men-only hotel with a members' bar, and Growlr Club above Man Bar is men only. Two men's saunas are also listed, Acqua Sauna and W3 Complex, both 18+. Each card has its stated policy and opening notes.

When do the bars open?

Most open from lunchtime and keep going to 2am or 3am at weekends, but hours vary and some bars publish none. Our open tonight page explains how to read the listed hours, and what's on lists shows and regular nights. If you are travelling for a big weekend, see our Pride page, and read the safety tips before heading out.

For a deeper look at the scene itself, the Rainbow Quarter directory covers venues in more detail.

open_tonight_intro: The hours here are the opening times listed for each venue, not a live feed. Bars change their schedules for bank holidays, private events, Pride weekends and quiet midweek spells in winter, and some places do not publish times at all. Treat the list as a planning guide rather than a promise, and check with the bar or its own pages before you set out, especially for a late-night plan or a midweek visit. Where a venue says its times are unpublished, we say so instead of guessing. For shows and regular nights, see what's on, and for places to sleep close to the action, visit our stays.
whats_on_intro: Blackpool's LGBTQ+ scene runs on a steady weekly rhythm, plus bigger seasonal shows and one-off events. Here you will find the drag cabaret seasons at Funny Girls, weekly quizzes, karaoke and game nights at the bars, brunches, choir and sports groups, and community events planned into 2027, such as the Rainbow Quarter street party in June and the Hand in Hand choir festival in August. Dates and prices come from the listings we hold, and they can change, so confirm with the organiser or venue before you book travel. Staying overnight? Check where to stay first, then see bars near your hotel and the open tonight guide.
